summary: Frontend-only validation of GymAxis user-feedback fixes (Trial billing, Analytics consolidation, Mobile App Builder light preview + App address). All 4 items pass. 1 minor browser-permission caveat on clipboard copy toast.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking the 'Copy link' button (data-testid=mab-app-address-copy) shows a 'Could not copy' red toast instead of 'App link copied' when navigator.clipboard.writeText is denied (headless Chromium without clipboard permission). The fallback to document.execCommand('copy') or selecting+copying the input/textarea is either missing or also fails silently. Real user browsers should mostly succeed, but on permission-denied/secure-context edge cases the user gets only the failure toast. Consider a textarea+execCommand fallback so the toast can still confirm success.

action_items: (Optional, LOW) Add execCommand('copy') fallback in AppAddressCard.handleCopy so the success toast still fires when navigator.clipboard.writeText is blocked (permissions-policy / iframed / headless contexts).
